title: Episode 8
summary: A man is found floating in the water with injuries suggesting a local sea monster is involved. He's also dealing with the grief of his son's unsolved murder from years ago.
method: The man had a fight with his wife's new SO earlier and succumbed to his injuries later. The victim created the misdirection himself because he didn't want the new SO to be convicted of his murder. He also found a bullet at the bottom of the sea and threw it on the boat, to help the team find his son's killer. The son's body is walled up in the office of the tour guide.
motive: The victim's son was killed because he witnessed a drug deal.
notes: The fact that the man found a singular bullet in the ocean that happened to be the bullet that killed his son is famously implausible
